name: Construction subcontractor back office: surety-ready job-cost/WIP bookkeeping + Illinois certified payroll (Chicagoland public-works subs)
summary: Customer unit = one Illinois specialty/sub contractor ($1-20M revenue) on a fixed monthly fee for accrual close + job-cost report + quarterly WIP schedule for the surety/bank, with an IDOL certified-payroll filing add-on for months with prevailing-wage work. Payroll itself stays on a platform of record (client-paid or pass-through). Founder performs production for the first ~12 clients; bookkeepers, a senior construction reviewer and a compliance specialist are hired on client-count triggers. One-time revenue = onboarding/clean-up project. No CPA title, no attest work, no lien filing, no surety sales.
evidence_notes: Bookkeeping is not restricted to CPAs in Illinois: 225 ILCS 450/8.05(b)(3) says bookkeeping and tax preparation 'are not restricted to licensed or registered CPAs' [A, DB-S014]; titles 'certified public accountant', 'public accountant', 'C.P.A.' or similar misleading terms are barred, civil penalty up to $10,000 per offense [A, DB-S015]; assurance/opinion reports are CPA practice [A, DB-S016].

Certified payroll mandate: monthly by the 15th, per project, for every contractor and sub on Illinois public works [A, C5-S014, C5-S017]; Davis-Bacon-only contracts do not file with IDOL; no filing for months without work; liability 'falls with the individual contractor'; a filer entering payrolls for two companies needs a separate log-in per company - i.e., third-party filing is contemplated [A, DB-S013]. SB1344 penalties reach the filing agent [C, C5-S019].

Price anchors: vertical construction bookkeeping lists $500-$1,000 (specialty sub), $900-$1,800 (WIP/retainage), $1,600-$2,800+ (multi-entity) [D, C5-S009]; the same vendor's Chicago ZIP pages show $150-$300 for small businesses (inconsistent) [D, DB-S029]; Bench accrual tiers $699-$999+ [B, C5-S003]; AI-only tiers $65-$99 [B, C5-S004/S005]; offshore 'construction-trained' bookkeeper $999/mo [D, C5-S035].

Certified-payroll software substitutes are cheap: LCPcertified $12/report or $145/mo for up to 5 active projects [B, DB-S020]; PaidReady $49-$99/mo [B, DB-S021]; Points North on ADP $175/mo + $7.50/report [B, C5-S013]. A done-for-you add-on must be sold on labour/penalty avoidance, not software.

Bond trigger: Illinois public works over $150,000 require performance/payment bonds until 2029 ($50,000 after), IDOT/Tollway over $500,000 [A, DB-S017]; SBA guarantees bonds up to $9M non-federal [A, DB-S028]. That surety underwriting asks for WIP schedules is industry practice, documented here only at D (vendor pages) - MISSING at A/B.

Prospect pool: City of Chicago SBI/LSLR/JOC awards to small contractors 2022-2026 [A, DB-S018]; 226 federal specialty-trade construction awards to Illinois-based recipients FY2025-27 [A, DB-S019]; Illinois has ~18,685 specialty-trade establishments, ~5,200 with 5-49 employees [C, C5-S002].

Incumbent benchmark: Paychex 82-83% client retention, >50% of payroll clients via referrals [A, WS02-S022] (incumbent economics). Illinois bookkeeping firms with <5 employees average ~$189k receipts; 5-9 employees ~$731k [C, C5-S001].

Lead volumes, conversion rates, attach rates and churn for THIS entrant are E. BLS wage data for bookkeepers could not be retrieved (API daily limit) - staff costs anchored on Census payroll/employee (C) plus burden (E).

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: No licence needed for bookkeeping [A, DB-S014]; setup = LLC, E&O/cyber policy, engagement letter, software (days-weeks) (E).
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Stage A/C: 1-6 weeks; owner decides; trigger = surety/bank request or first public award [E, WS02-028 memo].
drivers.founder_ramp_months__source: Founder must first learn construction accrual/WIP and IDOL template; referral relationships take months (E).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified owner conversations from public award lists (Chicago SBI/LSLR/JOC [A, DB-S018], USASpending [A, DB-S019]), ASA/FWC/CFMA events (Porte Brown lists these associations [B, DB-S023]) and CPA/surety-agent introductions. Volume E.
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Proposal requires a books review/discovery call (E).
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: No benchmark found; switching friction is low (client owns QBO file) but trust barrier is high for an unknown firm (E).
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Paychex: >50% of payroll clients via CPA/bank/broker referrals [A, WS02-S022] (incumbent). New-entrant referral rate E.
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: Paychex retention 82-83%/yr ~1.5%/mo [A, WS02-S022, incumbent]; contractors fail more often in downturns (E) - base slightly worse than Paychex.
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Blended: close+job cost+WIP $700-$1,000 (vertical list $500-$1,800 [D, C5-S009]; Bench accrual $699-$999 [B, C5-S003]) plus certified-payroll add-on ~$250-$350 on ~40% of clients for ~9.5 months (E; software substitute $49-$190/mo [B, DB-S020/S021, C5-S013]).
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Onboarding/clean-up (job setup, cost codes, opening WIP) typical at onboarding [E, WS02-028 memo]; price unbenchmarked.
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Direct costs here are per-client tools only (labour is in Staff): WIP tool $20-70/mo [D, C5-S036]; certified-payroll software $12/report or $145/mo per 5 projects [B, DB-S020]; QBO subscription normally client-paid (E). ~$100-160 per client-month.
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: Clean-up done by founder/staff (labour in Staff); direct cost = software/setup only (E).
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Meetings, travel, event fees per won client (E).
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Association dues (ASA Chicago, CFMA chapter), website; amounts MISSING (E).
drivers.dso_days__source: Monthly in advance by ACH/card is the norm for online bookkeepers (Bench annual prepay option [B, C5-S003]); contractors may resist autopay (E).
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Small accounting/bookkeeping practice multiples MISSING; insurance books trade at 5-7x profit [C, C5-S021] as a loose adjacent anchor; we use a lower SDE-style multiple (E).

staff.notes: ~$55-60k salary + ~20% burden; Census 541219 payroll/employee ~$45-55k [C, C5-S001]; 15 clients per bookkeeper (E). Founder covers first 12 clients.
~$85k + burden; reviews WIP/revenue recognition (E). Stage C base used $90k.
Maps hours to project/classification/county rate; IDOL template; fringe reconciliation (E).

overhead.notes: Bookkeeper E&O price MISSING (Insureon page not retrievable); SB1344 agent liability makes E&O essential [C, C5-S019] (E).

overhead.item: Practice software: Claude Team seats, practice-management, document capture, e-sign
overhead.notes: Claude Team $25/seat/mo monthly [B, DB-S022]; QBO Accountant access normally free to firms (E); practice-management ~$50/user (E).
